name: interpolate_frames
description: Generate intermediate animation frames by interpolating pixel colors between existing frames

name: draw_symmetry
description: Draw pixels with automatic mirroring (horizontal, vertical, or both)

name: generate_color_ramp
description: Generate a color ramp from shadow to highlight through a base color for pixel art shading

hue_shift.description: Degrees to shift hue in shadows/highlights (default: 0)

name: get_animation_preview
description: Get an animation preview as a horizontal frame strip image

name: flip_sprite
description: Flip sprite content horizontally or vertically

name: rotate_sprite
description: Rotate the sprite by 90, 180, or 270 degrees

name: shift_cel
description: Shift cel content by pixel offset, optionally wrapping edges

name: apply_dither
description: Fill a rectangle with a dithering pattern between two colors

name: load_reference_image
description: Load an external image as a reference layer

name: generate_animation_player_tres
description: Generate a Godot AnimationPlayer .tres resource from sprite animations

texture_path.description: Godot res:// path to sprite sheet

name: define_autotile_rules
description: Set up autotile bitmask metadata for a tileset sprite

name: get_autotile_rules
description: Read back the autotile bitmask metadata stored by define_autotile_rules (type, tile size, grid, and rules).

name: set_lospec_palette
description: Load a popular pixel art palette by name (Lospec collection)

name.description: Palette name: pico-8, endesga-32, arne-16, sweetie-16, resurrect-64, apollo, island-joy-16, slso8, na16, crimson

name: copy_between_sprites
description: Copy a layer's cel from one open sprite to another. Address sprites by stable id (from list_open_sprites, unambiguous) or filename.

source_filename.description: Source sprite filename (used if source_id omitted)

target_filename.description: Target sprite filename (used if target_id omitted)

target_layer.description: Target layer name (creates new layer if not found)

name: get_color_stats
description: Analyze the color usage in the active sprite (unique colors, most used, color distribution)

name: compare_frames
description: Compare two frames and report pixel differences

name: find_unused_colors
description: Find palette colors that are not used in any frame (indexed-mode sprites only). Duplicate palette entries are collapsed and results are capped by max_colors.

max_colors.description: Maximum number of unused colors to return (default: 64)

name: compare_screenshots
description: Compare two frames visually and return a diff image (red=changed, green=only in A, blue=only in B)

name: get_sprite_bounds
description: Get the bounding box of non-transparent content in the sprite

name: validate_animation
description: Validate animation setup: check for empty frames, inconsistent durations, orphan cels, and missing tags

name: get_cel
description: Get cel information at a specific layer and frame

name: set_cel_position
description: Move a cel's offset position

name: set_cel_opacity
description: Set a cel's opacity (0-255)

name: clear_cel
description: Clear the content of a cel

name: link_cels
description: Link cels across frames so they share content

name: put_pixel
description: Set a single pixel's color at the specified coordinates on the active layer and frame

color.description: Color as hex string (e.g. '#FF0000', '#FF000080' for semi-transparent)

name: put_pixels
description: Set multiple pixels at once (batch operation for efficiency). Each pixel is {x, y, color}

pixels.description: Array of pixel data [{x, y, color}, ...]

name: get_pixel
description: Read the color of a pixel at the specified coordinates

name: get_image_data
description: Get all pixel data from a cel as a flat array of hex colors (row-major order) or as base64 PNG

name: set_image_data
description: Replace the entire image data of a cel from a base64-encoded PNG (format=base64_png, needs 'data') or a row-major hex-color array (format=hex_array, needs 'pixels'+'width'+'height'). The hex_array shape mirrors get_image_data's output for round-trips.

pixels.description: Row-major array of hex colors (required when format=hex_array)

width.description: Image width in pixels (required when format=hex_array)

height.description: Image height in pixels (required when format=hex_array)

name: draw_line
description: Draw a line between two points using the specified color and brush size

name: draw_rect
description: Draw a rectangle (filled or outline)

name: draw_ellipse
description: Draw an ellipse (filled or outline) within the specified bounding box

name: flood_fill
description: Bucket fill at the specified point with the given color

name: draw_brush_stroke
description: Draw along a path of points using the specified brush

points.description: Array of points [{x, y}, ...] defining the stroke path

name: clear_image
description: Clear the entire image/cel to transparent or a specified color

color.description: Clear color as hex string (default: transparent)

name: replace_color
description: Replace all occurrences of one color with another in the active cel or entire sprite

name: outline
description: Draw an outline around non-transparent pixels in the cel

outside.description: Draw outline outside the shape (default: true)

name: execute_script
description: Execute arbitrary Lua code in Aseprite's scripting environment. Use this for operations not covered by other tools. The script can access all Aseprite API objects (app, Sprite, Image, etc.)

code.description: Lua code to execute. Return a value to include it in the response.

name: get_server_info
description: Report the extension version, MCP tool count, Aseprite version and Lua apiVersion, UI availability, and connection port. Useful for bug reports.

name: undo
description: Undo the last operation(s) in the active sprite

name: redo
description: Redo the last undone operation(s) in the active sprite

name: export_png
description: Export the sprite as PNG file(s). Can export single frame, all frames, or specific frame range

path.description: Output file path (use {frame} placeholder for multi-frame export)

frame.description: Specific frame to export (1-based). Omit for all frames

name: export_sprite_sheet
description: Export a sprite sheet (all frames in a grid) with optional JSON data file

tag.description: Export only frames from this animation tag

name: export_gif
description: Export the sprite as an animated GIF

name: export_tileset
description: Export the tileset of a tilemap layer as an image

name: export_layers
description: Export each layer as a separate image file

name: export_tags_as_sheets
description: Export each animation tag as a separate sprite sheet

json.description: Also export JSON data for each sheet (default: false)

name: get_frames
description: Get all frames in the active sprite with their durations

name: add_frame
description: Add a new frame to the sprite

after.description: Insert after this frame number (default: after current frame)

copy.description: Copy content from the reference frame (default: false, creates empty frame)

name: delete_frame
description: Delete a frame by number

name: set_frame_duration
description: Set the duration of a specific frame in milliseconds

name: set_frame_range_duration
description: Set the duration for a range of frames

name: set_active_frame
description: Navigate to a specific frame

name: duplicate_frame
description: Duplicate an existing frame

frame.description: Frame number to duplicate (default: current frame)

name: reverse_frames
description: Reverse the order of frames in a range

name: export_for_godot
description: Export sprite sheet + generate Godot SpriteFrames .tres resource. Creates both the PNG sprite sheet and a ready-to-use .tres file with animations based on Aseprite tags

output_dir.description: Godot project directory to export into (e.g. 'D:/project/assets/sprites')

name.description: Base name for output files (default: sprite filename without extension)

texture_path.description: Explicit Godot res:// path for the texture reference in the .tres (default: res://<name>.png)

name: export_atlas_texture
description: Export sprite regions as Godot AtlasTexture .tres files. Each slice becomes a separate AtlasTexture resource

texture_path.description: Godot res:// path to the source texture PNG

name: export_9patch_for_godot
description: Export a 9-patch sprite with slice data as a Godot NinePatchRect-compatible resource

slice_name.description: Name of the slice with 9-patch data

texture_path.description: Godot res:// path to the source texture PNG

name: export_tileset_for_godot
description: Export tileset as image + generate Godot TileSet .tres resource

texture_path.description: Explicit Godot res:// path for the texture reference (default: res://<name>.png)

name: get_animation_data
description: Get structured animation data (tags, frame regions, durations) suitable for Godot integration

sheet_type.description: Sheet layout to calculate regions for (default: horizontal)

name: generate_spriteframes_tres
description: Generate a Godot SpriteFrames .tres file from the current sprite's tags and frames without exporting images

texture_path.description: Godot res:// path to the sprite sheet texture

name: sync_to_godot_project
description: Export the sprite and copy all output files to a Godot project. Automatically detects tags for animations and exports both sprite sheet and SpriteFrames resource

godot_project_path.description: Root path of the Godot project (where project.godot is)

name: batch_export_for_godot
description: Export all open sprites to a Godot project in one operation

godot_project_path.description: Root path of the Godot project

name: get_layers
description: Get all layers in the active sprite with their properties (name, type, visibility, opacity, blend mode, hierarchy)

name: add_layer
description: Add a new layer to the active sprite

parent.description: Parent layer/group name to add into

below.description: Name of layer to insert below

name: delete_layer
description: Delete a layer by name

name.description: Name of the layer to delete

name: rename_layer
description: Rename a layer

name: set_layer_visibility
description: Show or hide a layer

visible.description: true to show, false to hide

name: set_layer_opacity
description: Set a layer's opacity (0-255)

name: set_layer_blend_mode
description: Set a layer's blend mode

name: reorder_layer
description: Move a layer to a new position in the stack

name: duplicate_layer
description: Duplicate a layer

name.description: Name of the layer to duplicate

name: merge_layer_down
description: Merge the specified layer with the one below it

name.description: Name of the layer to merge down

name: get_palette
description: Get all colors in the active sprite's palette

max_colors.description: Max number of colors to return (default: all)

name: set_palette_color
description: Set the color at a specific palette index

name: set_palette
description: Replace the entire palette with a new set of colors

name: add_palette_color
description: Add a color to the end of the palette

name: resize_palette
description: Resize the palette to a specific number of colors

name: load_palette
description: Load a palette from a file (.gpl, .pal, .ase, .png)

path.description: Absolute path to the palette file

name: save_palette
description: Save the palette to a file

path.description: Absolute path to save the palette

name: set_fg_color
description: Set the foreground drawing color

name: set_bg_color
description: Set the background drawing color

name: generate_palette_from_sprite
description: Generate a palette from the colors used in the current sprite

name: sort_palette
description: Sort the palette colors by hue, saturation, lightness, or individual RGB channels

name: import_palette_from_image
description: Extract colors from an image file and set them as the active sprite's palette

path.description: Absolute path to the image file

max_colors.description: Maximum number of colors to extract (default: 256)

name: select_rect
description: Select a rectangular region

name: select_ellipse
description: Select an elliptical region

name: select_all
description: Select the entire canvas

name: deselect
description: Clear the current selection

name: select_by_color
description: Select all pixels matching a specific color

name: get_selection
description: Get the current selection bounds and status

name: invert_selection
description: Invert the current selection

name: get_slices
description: Get all slices in the active sprite

name: create_slice
description: Create a new slice (named region) in the sprite

name: delete_slice
description: Delete a slice by name

name: set_slice_9patch
description: Set a slice's 9-patch / nine-slice center rectangle for scalable UI sprites

center_x.description: Center region X offset from slice origin

center_y.description: Center region Y offset from slice origin

name: set_slice_pivot
description: Set a slice's pivot point

pivot_x.description: Pivot X coordinate relative to slice

pivot_y.description: Pivot Y coordinate relative to slice

name: create_sprite
description: Create a new sprite with specified dimensions and color mode

name: open_sprite
description: Open a sprite file (.ase, .aseprite, .png, .gif, etc.)

name: save_sprite
description: Save the active sprite. Optionally save as a new file path

path.description: Optional new file path to save to

rename.description: When true and path is given, perform a real Save As so the sprite adopts the new filename (default: false = save a copy)

name: close_sprite
description: Close the active sprite or a specific sprite by filename

filename.description: Filename of sprite to close (default: active sprite)

name: get_sprite_info
description: Get detailed information about the active sprite (dimensions, color mode, frame count, layer count, etc.)

filename.description: Filename of sprite to inspect (default: active sprite)

name: list_open_sprites
description: List all currently open sprites in Aseprite

name: set_active_sprite
description: Set the active sprite by stable id (from list_open_sprites, unambiguous) or filename

id.description: Stable sprite id from list_open_sprites (preferred; unambiguous)

filename.description: Filename of the sprite to activate (ambiguous if multiple share a name)

name: resize_sprite
description: Resize the sprite canvas or scale the sprite content

scale_content.description: If true, scale content; if false, resize canvas only (default: true)

name: crop_sprite
description: Crop the sprite to the selection bounds or to visible content

mode.description: Crop to selection or content (default: content)

name: flatten_sprite
description: Flatten all visible layers into a single layer

name: get_sprite_screenshot
description: Get a PNG screenshot of the current sprite state (all visible layers flattened). Returns both image and metadata.

frame.description: Frame number to capture (default: current frame)

name: set_sprite_grid
description: Set the sprite grid size and offset (useful for tileset and sprite sheet workflows)

name: get_tags
description: Get all animation tags in the active sprite

name: create_tag
description: Create a new animation tag

name: delete_tag
description: Delete an animation tag by name

name: rename_tag
description: Rename an animation tag

name: set_tag_color
description: Set the color of an animation tag

name: set_tag_range
description: Change the frame range of an animation tag

name: create_character_template
description: Create a new sprite pre-configured for character animation with layers (shadow, outline, body, effects) and animation tags

size.description: Sprite size in pixels (default: 32, creates square sprite)

animations.description: Custom animations [{name, frames}, ...]. Default: idle(4), walk(6), attack(4)

name: create_tileset_template
description: Create a new sprite configured as a tileset grid with guide lines and proper grid settings

tile_size.description: Size of each tile in pixels (default: 16)

name: create_tilemap_layer
description: Create a new tilemap layer with the specified tile size

name: get_tileset
description: Get tileset information for a tilemap layer

name: set_tile
description: Set a tile at a grid position in a tilemap layer

name: get_tile
description: Get the tile index at a grid position in a tilemap layer

name: get_tilemap_info
description: Get tilemap grid dimensions, tile size, and used tile indices
